plan.notes: Source: official BCCC Catalog 2024-2025 (catoid=12), 'Program: General Studies Transfer, AA' — Suggested Sequence of Courses transcribed verbatim. Semester subtotals (15/14/16/15) reconcile to Program Total 60. History slots: HIS-Elective (HIS 101/110/151) in 1st semester must pair with H-Elective (HIS 102/111/152) in 2nd — Parts I and II of the same sequence per the catalog footnote; the footnote also states these history courses cannot count toward the General Education Requirements. 'X or Y' GE-elective slots seeded per corpus convention: code = first-listed option, options list all, catalog wording in choice_note. GE slots use catalog-worded codes. Per-course prerequisites are not published on the program page; prereq lists are empty.

courses.choice_note: Choose One: HIS 101, HIS 110, or HIS 151 (3 credits). These history courses cannot also be counted toward the General Education Requirements. Students must select Parts I and II of the same sequence: HIS 102 must follow HIS 101, HIS 111 must follow HIS 110, and HIS 152 must follow HIS 151.
